answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 49838 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: dua for nazar for baby not taking milk Question: Please, provide me a dua for nazar on bottle milk for my 3 months baby? She is not drinking milk. Please, give me a dua from the Quran. Answer ID: 49838 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 169/125/L=02/1435) You should keep on reciting Surah al-Falaq and Surah al-Naas thrice every morning and evening and blow on your daughter. She will start accepting the milk, in-shaAllah. You may recite the following dua thrice and blow: وَإِنْ يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
